The payout capability matrix lives here rather than in appsettings.json because configuration arrays merge by index: a base-file row would bleed its unset keys into any environment that overrides Capabilities:0, which is exactly what the integration harness does for its fake adapter.

PayPal Standard Payouts. Mauritius is 'send, receive and withdraw' in PayPal's country table (https://developer.paypal.com/docs/payouts/standard/reference/country-feature/) and Stripe publishes no MU corridor at all. GBP not MUR: the Mauritian rupee is not one of PayPal's payout currencies (https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/currency-codes/), so a MUR row would refuse every payment made over it. ProviderManaged and RequiresProviderOnboarding false because a PayPal payout goes to an address the member already has, not to an account this platform onboards. Payload, idempotency and duplicate handling confirmed against a live sandbox account by LivePayPalSandboxTests, 8 Sep 2026 - see docs/financial/paypal-adapter.md for what those runs found.

//Loops: Background loop cadence, 18 Sep 2026. The platform runs 33 timer-driven loops and production overrode none of them, so the shortest gap between database queries was one second and Neon's compute never suspended - which is what exhausted the previous account's monthly quota. Nothing here turns off work a screen depends on: figures still land, they land later. Retention sweeps are off because there is nothing yet to retain. The real fix is idle backoff and an outbox wake signal in the dispatcher itself; this is the configuration half.

Analytics.//: The projection sweep stays on: owner dashboards read the figures it builds, so turning it off empties them. Five minutes late is fine.
